chunks: The 'Ad had also disavowed. How was then My punishment and My commination!

key_terms.عَادٌ: The tribe of 'Ad, an ancient Arab people known for their strength and subsequent destruction.
key_terms.عَذَابِي: My punishment, referring to the divine retribution inflicted upon the disbelievers.
key_terms.نُذُرِ: Warnings or admonitions, referring to the messages delivered by prophets to warn people of consequences.

ai.seo_question: What happened to the tribe of 'Ad when they denied their prophet?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to illustrate the inevitability of divine retribution against those who arrogantly reject prophetic guidance, drawing a parallel to the Ahl al-Bayt's suffering at the hands of their detractors. The rhetorical question underscores that just as 'Ad was destroyed despite their strength, the warnings of the Imams carry equal weight for contemporary believers. This serves as a reminder that denial of truth leads to spiritual and physical ruin, a theme central to Shia historical consciousness.
